subject: POC setup blocked — can we unblock before month-end?
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@solvr.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + POC kickoff checklist

Samira — great to meet earlier. Quick recap + agreed next steps so nothing falls between the cracks:

- Scope we agreed: integration of Redwood inference for real-time reranking + embeddings for search (10k monthly queries)
- Tech contacts: Samira (your team), Michael O'Neil (infra lead) — Michael said he'd validate network/firewall requirements
- Next steps (owner / ETA):
  1) I'll send the POC runbook and quick checklist (attached) — Rachel — today
  2) Your infra validates VPC peering and egress rules — Michael — by 10/6
  3) Legal/procurement checks MSA & security evidence — Samira — by 10/8
  4) Kickoff call (30m) to run through onboarding + test dataset — target 10/12 once infra green

Attached: POC-Runbook.pdf (checklist + test payloads).

If anything here looks off, flag it and we can adjust. If procurement needs a different artifact, say the word and I’ll loop in our security team.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC kickoff checklist

Bumping this — checking if the procurement/infra timelines above are still accurate for you. With month-end approaching, we want to make sure we don’t miss the window for testing before your Q4 launch planning.

If easier, happy to set a 15-minute procurement sync to walk any outstanding asks.

—
Rachel

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + POC kickoff checklist — Solvr hanging

FYI forwarding the thread — Samira hasn’t replied to the bump. Looks like procurement is likely the bottleneck. My ask: can we try one of the following to re-engage?

- Offer a 30-day trial extension + assign a TAM to shorten security back-and-forth (low friction)
- Send SOC2 summary + sample syslogs to address the evidence ask proactively
- Offer a quick 15–20m legal/procurement Q&A with our GC and security lead to accelerate redlines

If you can waive the standard POC setup fee or provide a small pilot discount we can push for an on-the-fence approval. Thoughts? I can draft the outreach language.

—
Rachel

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@solvr.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neil <michael.oneil@dataforge.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC kickoff checklist

Thanks for the nudge, Rachel — apologies for the radio silence. Quick update from our side:

- Infra: Michael’s team started the network checklist but flagged data residency + egress controls as a blocker. They’ll need the exact IP ranges and an architecture diagram from Redwood to proceed.
- Procurement/Legal: our lead wants a SOC 2 summary and a clear data retention policy before signing the MSA redline. They also requested a sample audit log extract and an export process for deletion requests.
- Timeline: realistically, procurement has a 2–3 week review cycle unless we can get clarifying artifacts or a live answers session with your security/legal folks.

Can you share the SOC2 summary and the audit-log sample? Also, if Redwood can do a short call with our procurement/legal (15–20m) next week that would help.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Head of ML Engineering
Solvr, Inc.
samira.k@solvr.io | +1 (617) 555-0127

Samira — thanks for the context and totally understand where procurement is coming from. Attached are the items we can share immediately:

- SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf (one-page high-level summary of scope + controls)
- sample audit log extract (redacted) included in the SOC2 summary appendix
- MSA-redline-v2.docx (notes inline where common redlines are usually accepted)

We’re happy to do a 20-minute procurement call next Wed (10/14) at 10:00am PT — does that work? If helpful, I’ll include our security lead (Priya Natarajan) and legal (David Kim) so they can answer specific questions on retention, deletion, and export processes.

Also, to remove timing pressure on your team, we’ll extend the trial window by 30 days and assign a TAM for the kickoff — no charge. If that’s acceptable I’ll update the HubSpot deal record and get the TAM assigned today.

Suggested next step: reply with availability for 10/14 or propose a different slot; I’ll handle invites and attach the artifacts to the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to unblocking this.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
